units.id: news:avgi merchant|"Dejection. Reactor fuel grows in price each and every day."|115|0
units.english: "Dejection. Reactor fuel grows in price each and every day."
units.raw: `"Dejection. Reactor fuel grows in price each and every day."`

units.id: news:avgi merchant|"Relief. My ship barely made it to this port, ahead of a swarm of Aberrations!"|116|0
units.english: "Relief. My ship barely made it to this port, ahead of a swarm of Aberrations!"
units.raw: `"Relief. My ship barely made it to this port, ahead of a swarm of Aberrations!"`

units.id: news:avgi merchant|"Secrecy. The taxes levied by the Consonance can be evaded at certain ports, if one knows where to look."|117|0
units.english: "Secrecy. The taxes levied by the Consonance can be evaded at certain ports, if one knows where to look."
units.raw: `"Secrecy. The taxes levied by the Consonance can be evaded at certain ports, if one knows where to look."`

units.id: news:avgi merchant|"Defiance. I may not have a credit to my name, but no one will take my ship from me while I still live."|118|0
units.english: "Defiance. I may not have a credit to my name, but no one will take my ship from me while I still live."
units.raw: `"Defiance. I may not have a credit to my name, but no one will take my ship from me while I still live."`

units.id: news:avgi merchant|"Doubt. If the Aberrant could reach us inside the Tangled Shroud, they would have by now. I don't see why the new taxes are necessary."|119|0
units.english: "Doubt. If the Aberrant could reach us inside the Tangled Shroud, they would have by now. I don't see why the new taxes are necessary."
units.raw: `"Doubt. If the Aberrant could reach us inside the Tangled Shroud, they would have by now. I don't see why the new taxes are necessary."`

units.id: news:avgi merchant|"Irony. The only reason every freighter isn't automated these days is piracy. Thank you, pirates!"|120|0
units.english: "Irony. The only reason every freighter isn't automated these days is piracy. Thank you, pirates!"
units.raw: `"Irony. The only reason every freighter isn't automated these days is piracy. Thank you, pirates!"`

units.id: news:avgi merchant|"Intrigue. Did you hear about the new trade route through the Tangled Shroud? I smell profit!"|121|0
units.english: "Intrigue. Did you hear about the new trade route through the Tangled Shroud? I smell profit!"
units.raw: `"Intrigue. Did you hear about the new trade route through the Tangled Shroud? I smell profit!"`

units.id: news:avgi merchant|"Pride. My shipping company helped over a thousand Avgi escape Stilacrest before its skyhook was broken. I still get letters of gratitude to this day!"|122|0
units.english: "Pride. My shipping company helped over a thousand Avgi escape Stilacrest before its skyhook was broken. I still get letters of gratitude to this day!"
units.raw: `"Pride. My shipping company helped over a thousand Avgi escape Stilacrest before its skyhook was broken. I still get letters of gratitude to this day!"`

units.id: news:avgi merchant|"Satisfaction. My transport business escaped the Incursion with nearly all of its ships intact. Now I'm one of the richest Avgi in the galaxy!"|123|0
units.english: "Satisfaction. My transport business escaped the Incursion with nearly all of its ships intact. Now I'm one of the richest Avgi in the galaxy!"
units.raw: `"Satisfaction. My transport business escaped the Incursion with nearly all of its ships intact. Now I'm one of the richest Avgi in the galaxy!"`

units.id: news:avgi merchant|"Sadness. It's a shame we lose a convoy to the Aberrant nearly every week."|124|0
units.english: "Sadness. It's a shame we lose a convoy to the Aberrant nearly every week."
units.raw: `"Sadness. It's a shame we lose a convoy to the Aberrant nearly every week."`

units.id: news:avgi politician|"Exasperation. Everyone in the Assembly knows the taxes and quotas are unpopular, but there's no other way to fight the war against the Aberrant."|150|0
units.english: "Exasperation. Everyone in the Assembly knows the taxes and quotas are unpopular, but there's no other way to fight the war against the Aberrant."
units.raw: `"Exasperation. Everyone in the Assembly knows the taxes and quotas are unpopular, but there's no other way to fight the war against the Aberrant."`

units.id: news:avgi politician|"Pride. Before the Incursion, there were over a thousand recognized independent polities among the Avgi. Now, the Consonance is ready to unite our species."|151|0
units.english: "Pride. Before the Incursion, there were over a thousand recognized independent polities among the Avgi. Now, the Consonance is ready to unite our species."
units.raw: `"Pride. Before the Incursion, there were over a thousand recognized independent polities among the Avgi. Now, the Consonance is ready to unite our species."`

units.id: news:avgi politician|"Mocking. Why of course, I never considered before that we should simply build more ships to defeat the Aberrant. Have you considered petitioning the Assembly with your idea?"|152|0
units.english: "Mocking. Why of course, I never considered before that we should simply build more ships to defeat the Aberrant. Have you considered petitioning the Assembly with your idea?"
units.raw: `"Mocking. Why of course, I never considered before that we should simply build more ships to defeat the Aberrant. Have you considered petitioning the Assembly with your idea?"`

units.id: news:avgi politician|"Humor. Reaching a consensus among hundreds of independent polities is more difficult than fighting an existential war for the survival of your species. And less exciting."|153|0
units.english: "Humor. Reaching a consensus among hundreds of independent polities is more difficult than fighting an existential war for the survival of your species. And less exciting."
units.raw: `"Humor. Reaching a consensus among hundreds of independent polities is more difficult than fighting an existential war for the survival of your species. And less exciting."`

units.id: news:avgi politician|"Reservation. While those of us who understand matters of policy accept that the war economy is necessary, the people are beginning to chafe under the long economic austerity it has imposed. More needs to be done to inform the common people lest we lose the war behind the front lines."|154|0

units.id: news:avgi military|"Pensive. Sometimes I wonder at the future of our species, and whether we are up to the task of defending it."|178|0

units.id: news:avgi military|"Resolve. The Guard is the only thing standing between our people and the Aberrant, and I intend to do my duty or die trying."|179|0
